what_this_is: Lesson-body <jp reading> spans whose reading was copied from a bank sentence's stored kana before token_reading_audit.json re-read that sentence. Reading attribute only: the rendered text does not move. The applied tables that first wrote them (n3_review_furigana.json, furigana_residue.json) carry the corrected reading too (`amended`), so on a replay they write it directly and this table finds every span already applied; on the live index it moves the old attribute to the new one.

spans.to: <jp reading="くじになってはじめてかれはかえってきた。">９時になってはじめて彼は帰ってきた。</jp>
